exposure: c.65-13G>A variant in the RNASEH2B gene
new splice site leading to an 11-base-pair extension in exon 2
frameshift (p.Glu22Valfs*7) and subsequent truncation of the RNASEH2B protein
cohort: A newborn from consanguineous parents presenting with microcephaly, recurrent hemorrhagic strokes, and other severe neurological and systemic manifestations.
finding: A newly identified intronic RNASEH2B variant (c.65-13G>A) creates a new splice site, leading to a frameshift and truncation of the RNASEH2B protein, which is elucidated as the pathogenic mechanism for severe neurological manifestations of Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome in a newborn.
